# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/ilias-ant/adversarial-validation/security/advisories/new).
You will receive a response as soon as possible 🙂.
